family_name: Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Expanding

spec.description:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Expanding are innovative suspended
acoustic partitions that concertina open to define zones and control sound in
open-plan spaces. Manufactured from 12mm Cube polyester panel with precision
laser-cut geometry, the patented expanding design pulls open to grow by 100% in
size without generating any cut-out material waste. Suspended from the ceiling
via an aluminium channel and cable system, it introduces spatial separation and
acoustic absorption while maintaining openness and natural light.

install:
Determine suspension anchor points on the
ceiling at required spacing

Fix ceiling connectors securely to structural
ceiling or soffit

Thread suspension wires into ceiling connectors and adjust
to desired height

Attach Frontier channel to top of the Cascade screen using
sliders

Carefully pull and concertina the expanding screen downward to reveal
the pattern

Lock the bottom in place using optional floor-fixing kit or allow
to hang freely

Fit black extrusion end caps to the channel ends for a clean
finish
selection_checklist:
Select expanding pattern design (E1, E2,
E3, E4, E5, or E6)

Select colour from Autex Cube palette (over 20 colours
available)

Confirm ceiling height and check if standard 1m suspension cable
is sufficient

Choose top-only suspension or top-and-base fixed
configuration
accessories:
Cascade suspension kit (Frontier channel, ceiling connectors, 1m wires,
sliders)

Extended suspension cables (if ceiling
height exceeds 3.5m)
limitations:
Designed as a spatial divider and
acoustic baffle, not a physical security barrier

Suspension anchors must be
fixed to structurally sound ceiling elements

Do not apply excessive tensile
downward force on expanded pattern web

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Expanding are
ceiling-suspended acoustic space dividers made from 12mm Cube polyester panels
that concertina open to double their size without material waste. By expanding
from 1200mm to 2400mm, these screens introduce visual semi-privacy and diffuse
sound reflections in noisy open-plan layouts. Supported by an aluminium Frontier
channel suspension kit, with Group 1 fire resistance and minimum 80% recycled
content, they zone spaces without impeding light or air circulation.
